SUMMARY: Edge/vehicle telemetry startup evaluating Redwood Dedicated + Private for sub-50ms p95 inference on short chat-like telemetry prompts and high-volume reranking. High interest in Optimize (batching/caching/quantization) to hit cost targets

RECENT TIMELINE:
- 2026-01-28: Intro call (Maya/Carlos) — discussed use case, basic SLOs. Fireflies: ff_2026-01-28_1412.

USE-CASE / REQUIREMENTS (customer language):
- "We need deterministic <50ms p95 for short policy-check prompts at scale; cost must be < $X per 1k requests — can't sustain high per-token charges."
- Workload: very short context (50-150 tokens), high QPS spikes when fleet syncs, reranking on edge predictions.
- Targets: p50 ~20ms, p95 <=50ms, throughput burst to 200 req/s for 30s windows.

TECHNICAL NOTES / POC ASKED FOR:
- Perf benchmarking: want end-to-end numbers (client network + routing) for 3 model variants (full FP16, 4-bit quant, distilled), measuring latency distribution and token cost.
- Batch/caching: interested in micro-batching (<=8) vs continuous batching, KV-prefix caching across sessions for repeated telemetry patterns.
- Quantization: test int4/int8 profiles; measure quality delta on rerank metrics (MRR) and hallucination risks.
- Routing: automatic fallback to cheaper model when Dedicated pool saturated; prefer warm-standby model instances.

SECURITY / CONTRACT / DEPLOYMENT NOTES:
- Must run control plane in VPC with optional on-prem inference in custody for regulatory customers.
- Requires SSO (SAML), KMS integration, and audit trails for every inference decision (request id -> model version mapping).
- Data residency: EU customers require on-prem or regionally pinned hosts.

DECISIONS / ECONOMICS:
- Customer asked for a cost model: line items for Dedicated reserved capacity, burst credits, and Optimize savings for batching/caching/quantization.
- Rough internal AR math shows ROI if token/unit cost reduced ~30% at target latencies.
